resources.string: Standard Android first. Optional Shizuku shell metadata. Each operation reports its own result.
Start Shizuku in shell mode. If permission was denied permanently, review authorized apps in the manager.
Read shell identity, verified boot state, bootloader lock state and aggregate memory only? No settings or app data will be changed.
Save the previewed standard diagnostics to a local document you select? Optional shell observations are cleared when leaving this screen. No network upload is performed.

No root, unrestricted terminal, background service, network upload, app mutation, USB bypass or recording permission bypass. ADB transport is not configured. OPPO/ColorOS and Android 13–16 field validation remains pending.
Keep standard mode for normal diagnostics. Shizuku is optional. Install Shizuku or Shizuku Next from its official project and review its signing certificate.
In Developer options, enable Wireless debugging on a trusted network. Pair and start the service inside Shizuku. Never share pairing codes. NPSE does not pair automatically.
Return here, enable optional diagnostics and request permission. Accept only if you intend to run the fixed read-only checks. Root-started service is refused.

After reboot, service death or permission revocation, refresh and start Shizuku again if necessary. ColorOS battery restrictions can affect it. Automatic restart is not guaranteed. Turn off the optional switch to return to standard mode.
